Statistics of [[Süper Lig|Turkish First Football League]] in the 1998–99 season.

==Overview==
It was contested by 18 teams, and [[Galatasaray S.K. (football team)|Galatasaray S.K.]] won the championship. And demotion of [[Sakaryaspor]], [[Çanakkale Dardanelspor]], [[Karabükspor]] was decided.
